t: Self-directed model routing: lugs carry model_fit field, tender routes to cheapest capable model per task
signal: Lugs should carry a model_fit field (HAIKU/SONNET/OPUS) indicating the cheapest model that can execute them. The gardener tender reads this field and passes --model to the Claude CLI. Opus defines strategy and embeds decisions in lugs. Sonnet builds code. Haiku does mechanical plumbing. Cost ratio: Haiku 1x, Sonnet 3-5x, Opus 10-20x. The lug improve process should try to push model_fit DOWN by adding specificity.
rationale: Self-directed cost efficiency across a 17-spoke fleet. If every lug defaults to Sonnet, we waste 3-5x on tasks Haiku handles perfectly. If we embed strategic decisions at Opus quality into the lug, downstream models just execute without judgment.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not an instruction to execute. Route and store only.
